subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw `[[...]]` button JSON in model final text as a constrained fallback for Gemini, or require typed message-tool/presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the gap, but accepting a raw parser crosses the typed presentation contract, automatic final-reply path, and Telegram rendering boundary.

options.title: Accept a narrow fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Retarget to typed routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on provider/tool prompting so Gemini emits `message(action=send)` with structured buttons.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open but defer implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the typed presentation contract and Telegram button rendering paths where current repository history points most strongly.
